\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-90},
  title = {CI warns about a stale \texorpdfstring{\texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}lock}}{dvc.lock} instead of blocking the merge},
  date = {2026-10-22},
  milestone = {M4: Model Deployment},
  topic = {CI/CD, Reproducibility},
  participants = {@lukas2510 decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/193}{issue \#193})},
  decision = {A non-blocking CI job reports every stage whose git-tracked dependencies, parameters or command differ from what \texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}lock} records, in its job summary and as one warning on the pull request, on every pull request and every push to \texttt{main}.
It filters \texttt{dvc status} and skips the data and models CI does not have.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A required check: every edit of stage code, comments included, would need a 15-30 minute tracked re-run with new MLflow runs before the merge.
\item No check and a re-sync before each delivery: a stale lock stays invisible until the delivery, as it did during M4.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} During M4, five changes to stage code left the lock stale until \#183 re-ran the whole pipeline, and no check noticed.
One of them changed only \texttt{recommenditos/\allowbreak{}config.\allowbreak{}py}, which every stage lists, so even a comment there makes all 16 stages stale.
The warning shows this on the pull request that causes it, and the re-run can wait for a convenient moment, at the latest the delivery.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI drafted the three options and recommended the warning in \#193, from the stale-lock incident of \#183; @lukas2510 accepted it and asked for it to be implemented.
AI then built the check, and on the real repository a comment-only edit of \texttt{config.\allowbreak{}py} reported all 16 stages while \texttt{main} reported none.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session orchestrating M4, prompt ``please do you recommendations here: \#193, dvc.lock-Check in der CI''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/193}{Issue \#193}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/183}{PR \#183}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/205}{PR \#205}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/tools/stale_lock.py}{\texttt{tools/\allowbreak{}stale\_\allowbreak{}lock.\allowbreak{}py}}.},
